newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade moderate - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade moderate - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 8,100 slaughter steers and 3,100 heifers; 70,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,000 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 100 head or 2 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00-64.25. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00-64.25. Confirmed - 11,200
